summary: Canyon Peak, Josephine County OR: L-4 cab built 1941 on the Siskiyou NF, removed in the 1960s; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Cab removed in the 1960s by the register's account; no source describes remains on the summit

events.note: Trail built to the peak, then a 14 by 14 L-4 lookout house erected; Josephine County list gives an L-4-36 ground house
June 1958 newspaper item: a man appointed to the post but not yet sent; July 1958 a stationed lookout's husband was present for the summer
Register says removed sometime in the 1960s; firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1960s; exact year not documented
Registered November 12, 2019; nominated by Tammy McLeod

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed sometime in the 1960s, firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1960s, and the Josephine County list marks the removal with a question mark. The story reports the 1960s as a range and gives no exact year.
The register and Forest Lookouts describe an L-4 cab; the Josephine County list adds a -36 designation and calls it a ground house. Treated as one L-4 cab.

notes_for_editor: Gone lookout on the Siskiyou NF. Brief record was accurate for the 1941 build and 2019 registration; added the 1958 staffing and the 1960s removal from the sources. No source describes the summit today, and access is not described, so facts.access is left out. The brief elevation (1494.4 m) matches the register's 4,903 ft. The 1943 NGS station note on the Forest Lookouts page is not used because it does not describe the site today. Quote-level staffing evidence rests on Medford Mail Tribune clippings quoted second-hand on the Forest Lookouts page. Used 1 WebSearch and about 8 page reads, over budget, because the first search page was thin.
